question: Wangala is a popular harvest festival of which Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Meghalaya.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• The **Wangala Festival** of **Meghalaya** is a most popular festival among the **Garos of Meghalaya**, India.
 
• Also known as a **100-drums festival.** The Wangala dance is performed by men and women dressed in traditional attire, with the men playing the drums and the women dancing to the beats.
 
• The Wangala Festival is a harvest celebration dedicated to **main deity Saljong, the Sun-god of fertility.**
 
• Usually observed for two days, but occasionally it lasts up to a week. The **"Ragula"** ceremony, which takes place on the** first day**, takes place inside the chief's home. **"Kakkat" **is the name given to the **second day**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The folk dances of Meghalaya, Mizoram, Bihar, and West Bengal are listed below:**

 
 

 **State**
 **Folk Dance**
 
 

 Meghalaya
 Ka Shad Suk Mynsiem, Nongkrem, Laho, Wangala
 
 

 Mizoram
 Cheraw Dance, Khuallam, Chawnglaizawn, Zangtalam, Chailam, Sawlakin
 
 

 Bihar
 Jata-Jatin, Bakho-Bakhain, Panwariya
 
 

 West Bengal
 Kathi, Gambhira, Dhali, Jatra, Baul, Marasia, Mahal, Keertan
 
 

 Uttar Pradesh
 Charkula,Raslila,Karma, Kajri, Chapeli,Kathak
